integrity: The theorem and asymptotics are derived analytically from the specified spherical probability measure. Numerical checks are corroborative; independent audit and validation have not been performed.
limitations: Result concerns center-constrained Haar lines in Euclidean three-dimensional orthotopes only.
The 1981 Coleman random-probe paper remains a material historical-priority risk because its full text was inaccessible.
Finite executable checks do not prove the continuum theorem.
title: Exact Haar central-chord law of rectangular boxes and its singularity thresholds
